narr: Ample monsoon moisture and slow storm motion allowed heavy rain and flash flooding over Gila County.
ev: A USGS stream gage on Tonto Creek (TNRA3) rose just over a foot between 600 PM and 1000 PM. The water returned to a stable level by noon on the 25th.
lsr: A USGS stream gage on Tonto Creek (TNRA3) reported just over a foot rise in water level.
